status: Fixed before this numerical sweep; retrospective to previously observed audit data
population: 84 initially correct sources in canonical EB18
ranking_inputs: clean top-two margin divided by source horizon_steps

schemes.uniform: Equal source weights across all 84 sources
schemes.lowest_quartile: Equal positive weights on the 21 lowest-margin sources; all other initial weights zero
schemes.lowest_half: Equal positive weights on the 42 lowest-margin sources; all other initial weights zero
schemes.half_uniform_half_quartile: 50 percent weight on uniform84 plus 50 percent weight on uniform lowest21
schemes.half_uniform_half_linear_rank: 50 percent weight on uniform84 plus 50 percent weight proportional to 85-rank (rank1 is lowest margin)

primary_comparison: half_uniform_half_quartile versus uniform at equal total candidate budgets
sensitivity_comparisons: hard quartile, hard half, linear-rank mixture; raw versus horizon-normalized clean-margin rank
allocation: Capped proportional allocation in real numbers, then floor and assign remaining units by largest fractional remainders, ties ascending source_index. A saturated hard-focus policy assigns overflow uniformly to remaining uncapped sources.
candidate_sampling: Uniform distinct candidates without replacement independently within each source, using the allocated integer count
outcome_use: Only after allocation, to compute exact finite-population hypergeometric coverage; never used in weights, ranking, caps, redistribution, or budgets
metrics: probability of finding all13 vulnerable sources
expected fraction of total adverse mass in discovered sources
cost: Number of hypothetical candidate forward evaluations; common clean-source scores are already available. No new model inference occurs in this computation.
no_tuning: No scheme coefficient, threshold, or budget is chosen by maximizing measured outcomes; no new policy is added after seeing the sweep
interpretation: Fixed-panel retrospective policy comparison; no held-out policy generalization or empirical runtime/energy claim
